lines.en: label nikilovesyou3:
scene nikilovesyou1
: I’m going to make tea. Do you want any?
lines.zh: : 我去泡茶。你要吗？

lines.en: : I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我不用。

lines.en: : Are you sure? Is there anything {i}else{/i} you want? Water? Something a little harder to take the edge off?
lines.zh: : 确定吗？还有{i}别的{/i}想要的吗？水？还是要来点烈的缓一缓？

lines.en: : I’m okay. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 我真的没事。谢谢你。

lines.en: : Okay. I’ll be right back, but make yourself at home. Should be easy since you {i}did{/i} basically live here when we were kids.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我马上回来，你别客气。反正我们小时候你基本{i}就住在这儿{/i}，应该很容易。

lines.en: : Okay...
: Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou2
After leaving the place where everything went dark, we return to Niki’s childhood home.
lines.zh: 离开那个一切陷入黑暗的地方之后，我们回到了 Niki 小时候的家。

lines.en: She collected a key from under the welcome mat to use on the door and said her parents don’t mind if she still crashes here from time to time.
lines.zh: 她从门垫底下摸出一把钥匙开了门，说她爸妈不介意她偶尔还回来借住。

lines.en: They kept her room the same- and while I can’t currently remember its layout from any legitimate memories, I remember bits from when it was forced into my head a little over a year ago.
lines.zh: 他们把她的房间原样留着——虽然我现在凭真正的记忆想不起它的陈设，但还记得一年多前被硬塞进我脑子里的那些片段。

lines.en: This is where she must have written me those letters — the prison I locked her in when I left her behind.
lines.zh: 她应该就是在这里给我写了那些信的——那是我抛下她时，把她关进去的牢房。

lines.en: I can only imagine how many tears have been shed on the very bed I’m sitting on — how many times I’ve been cursed and ridiculed without so much as sparing a thought over her.
lines.zh: 我只能想象，我正坐着的这张床上流过多少眼泪——我又被诅咒、被嘲笑过多少次，却从未为她多想过哪怕一下。

lines.en: Akira.
lines.zh: Akira。

lines.en: The name rings out in the back of my head.
lines.zh: 这个名字在我脑后回响。

lines.en: Who {i}knows{/i} that name?
lines.zh: 谁{i}知道{/i}这个名字？

lines.en: Ami surely does, yet she’s never said it to me.
lines.zh: Ami 一定知道，可她从来没对我说过。

lines.en: I’m sure Maya knows too...maybe even Ayane.
lines.zh: Maya 肯定也知道……说不定连 Ayane 都知道。

lines.en: Have they been saying it all along? Have I been blocking it out?
lines.zh: 她们一直都在这么叫我吗？是我一直把它屏蔽掉了？

lines.en: It’s one word- it shouldn’t make me feel this different.
lines.zh: 不过是一个词——它不该让我觉得自己变得这么不一样。

lines.en: But I don’t deserve a name. I feel {i}real{/i} now. I’m suddenly a person instead of just a title, and...I shouldn’t be gifted something so valuable when everything else is already wrapped around my fingers.
lines.zh: 可我不配拥有一个名字。我现在感觉自己是{i}真{/i}实的了。我突然成了一个人，而不只是一个头衔，而且……别的一切都已经绕在我指尖了，我不该再被赐予这么珍贵的东西。

lines.en: The weight of five forbidden letters presses down on my neck and there is nothing I can do but hang my head in response.
lines.zh: 五个被禁止的字母的重量压在我的脖子上，我所能做的只有低下头回应它。

lines.en: Something plays on the television, but I can’t focus enough to see what.
lines.zh: 电视里放着什么，可我无法集中注意力去看清。

lines.en: All I can think is of what will happen next.
lines.zh: 我满脑子只想着接下来会发生什么。

lines.en: There is only one way I have ever known comfort — and I am here alone with a girl who wants nothing more than to comfort me.
lines.zh: 我所知道的慰藉只有一种——而此刻我和一个只想安慰我的女孩单独待在一起。

lines.en: But is {i}this{/i} the way it’s meant to be?
lines.zh: 可事情本该是{i}这{/i}样发生的吗？

lines.en: Is {i}this{/i} what she envisioned under luxury blankets in fancy hotels, whispering my name into the dark corner of a room while doing to herself what I was not present to do?
lines.zh: {i}这{/i}就是她曾经在高级酒店的名贵毛毯下幻想过的场景吗——在房间黑暗的角落里低声念着我的名字，对我本该在场去做的事自己动手？

lines.en: I have never whispered her name.
lines.zh: 我从来没有低声念过她的名字。

lines.en: I have never whispered anyone’s.
lines.zh: 我从来没有低声念过任何人的名字。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou3
: That’s not true. You used to whisper {i}my{/i} name all the time. Just because I {i}made{/i} you doesn’t mean it doesn’t count.
lines.zh: : 才不是呢。你以前就老是低声念{i}我的{/i}名字。就算是我把你{i}造出来{/i}的，那也算数。

lines.en: I’m seeing things.
lines.zh: 我在看见一些东西。

lines.en: Things I am not meant to see.
lines.zh: 一些我不该看见的东西。

lines.en: This isn’t how it’s meant to be.
lines.zh: 事情不该是这样。

lines.en: : I wonder what would happen if you reached out and touched me right now?
lines.zh: : 我在想，要是你现在伸手碰我一下，会发生什么？

lines.en: : Do you think I’d feel it?...Do you think {i}you’d{/i} feel it?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我能感觉到吗？……你觉得{i}你{/i}能感觉到吗？

lines.en: : You still {i}can{/i} feel, right? You don’t miss me so much that you’re {i}physically{/i} numb now too, I hope.
lines.zh: : 你{i}还能{/i}感觉得到吧？你总不至于想我想到连{i}身体{/i}都麻木了吧，我希望。

lines.en: Can you see her too?
lines.zh: 你也能看见她吗？

lines.en: Are you even there at all?
lines.zh: 你到底在不在那里？

lines.en: : You can’t ignore me forever, Akira.
lines.zh: : 你不能永远无视我，Akira。

lines.en: : The harder you try to forget me, the more I’ll want to show up.
lines.zh: : 你越努力想忘记我，我就越想出现。

lines.en: : Akiraaaa~
lines.zh: : Akira 啊——

lines.en: : Aki-kun~
lines.zh: : Aki 君——

lines.en: : Doff thy name! And for that name which is no part of thee, take all myself.
lines.zh: : 抛弃你的名字吧！为了那个本不属于你的名字，把我整个人都拿去。

lines.en: : O nature, what hadst thou to do in hell, when thou didst bower the spirit of a fiend in moral paradise of such sweet flesh?
lines.zh: : 噢，造化啊，你在地狱里究竟有何勾当，竟把恶鬼的灵魂安放进如此甜美的肉体的道德天堂？

lines.en: : You’re mixing monologues...
lines.zh: : 你在把几段独白混在一起了……

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou4
: Ah! He speaks!
lines.zh: : 啊！他说话了！

lines.en: : Quick, tell me you love me before you fuck your ex-girlfriend. It should be easy. You’ve done it plenty of times before.
lines.zh: : 快点，在你干你前女友之前先说你爱我。这应该很容易。你以前做过那么多次了。

lines.en: : Ugh. You’re such a Montague sometimes.
lines.zh: : 唉。你有时候可真像 Montague 家的人。

lines.en: scene black
: Hey, back. Sorry. Slide over a bit.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我回来了。抱歉。往边上挪一点。

lines.en: : Yeah...sure.
scene nikilovesyou5
: You sure you don’t want anything? You’re probably dehydrated after walking around all day.
lines.zh: : 你确定什么都不想要？逛了一整天，你大概脱水了。

lines.en: : I’ll be fine. But thanks.
lines.zh: : 我没事的。不过谢谢你。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou6
: Okay...You know where the kitchen is if you wind up changing your mind.
lines.zh: : 好吧……你要是改主意了，知道厨房在哪儿。

lines.en: : What are you watching? Who’s the girl with the pink hair? And what’s that weird grey stuff they’re eating?
lines.zh: : 你在看什么？那个粉头发的女孩是谁？还有他们吃的那个灰色的奇怪东西是什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I haven’t been paying much attention.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我一直没怎么看。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou7
: Do you want to take a nap? I can leave you alone if you want. My parents won’t mind if you stay the night. We’re well past the age where it would be weird.
lines.zh: : 你想睡一会儿吗？你想的话我可以让你一个人待着。我爸妈不介意你留宿。我们都早过了会让人觉得别扭的年纪了。

lines.en: : And Noriko doesn’t come by much anymore, so you wouldn’t have to worry about her finding you here and getting the wrong idea or something.
lines.zh: : 而且 Noriko 现在也不怎么来了，所以你不用担心她在这里撞见你、误会什么之类的。

lines.en: : {i}Would{/i} it be the wrong idea?
lines.zh: : 那{i}会{/i}是误会吗？

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou8
: You tell me. You were nearly catatonic on the way over. I’m in big-sister mode right now because I figured I should be gentle, but I can swap back to ex or childhood friend if you like.
lines.zh: : 你告诉我啊。过来的路上你几乎都僵住了。我现在是“大姐姐模式”，因为我觉得该温柔点，不过要是你喜欢，我可以切回前女友或者青梅竹马。

lines.en: : Just be yourself. There doesn’t need to be a “mode.”
lines.zh: : 就做你自己就好。不需要什么“模式”。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou9
: Uh...maybe “mode” was the wrong way of putting it? It’s not an act or anything. All of those “modes” are real parts of who I am. I just didn’t want to overstimulate you or...something.
lines.zh: : 呃……也许“模式”这个说法不太对？那不是演戏什么的。那些“模式”都是真实的我。我只是不想刺激到你，或者……什么的。

lines.en: : Maybe I should have just made you tea after all?
lines.zh: : 也许我一开始就该只给你泡茶？

lines.en: : I really don’t deserve you, Niki...You’re better than this. You know you are.
lines.zh: : 我真的配不上你，Niki……你值得更好的。你心里清楚。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou10
: Better than what? Being there for someone who needs me? Someone I’ve made it {i}pretty{/i} apparent I’d do anything for today?
lines.zh: : 比什么更好？比陪在一个需要我的人身边更好？我表现得已经{i}很明显{/i}了吧，今天我愿意为他做任何事。

lines.en: : I’m not {i}above{/i} you just because I unlocked compassion in my skill tree and you skipped over that in favor of...penis size or something.
lines.zh: : 我不会因为在技能树上点开了“同情”就比你{i}高一等{/i}，你只是跳过了它，去点了……阴茎尺寸之类的。

lines.en: : Worthy investment. Compassion gets you nowhere.
lines.zh: : 值得的投资。同情心什么地方都到不了。

lines.en: : It got you into my room.
lines.zh: : 它把我弄进了你的房间。

lines.en: : It’s equally plausible penis size got me into this room.
lines.zh: : 阴茎尺寸把我弄进这个房间的可能性也一样大。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou11
: Pfft...Are you feeling a little better now? Your less miserable side is starting to show.
lines.zh: : 噗……你现在感觉好一点了吗？你没那么惨的那一面开始露出来了。

lines.en: : My head hurts. My legs hurt. I’m exhausted. I’m congested. But on the bright side, I can formulate thoughts again. And that’s a good sign, I guess.
lines.zh: : 头也疼。腿也疼。我累坏了。还鼻塞。不过往好处想，我又能组织语言了。我想那是个好兆头。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou12
: You’ve gotta start somewhere.
lines.zh: : 总得有个开始。

lines.en: : Just please forgive me if I start crying once you’re a little more stable. I was holding myself together for your sake and that dam is bound to burst sooner or later.
lines.zh: : 只是等你稍微稳定一点之后我要是哭了，请原谅我。我一直是为了你才撑着的，那道堤坝迟早要决口。

lines.en: : Please don’t cry for me, Niki. It’s not worth it.
lines.zh: : 别为我哭，Niki。不值得。

lines.en: : You know that dude Noah who built the ark to put all those animals on? Pretty sure he did that sometime around when you ran out on me when he caught wind of how much I’d been crying.
lines.zh: : 你知道那个造方舟把所有动物都装上去的家伙 Noah 吗？他大概是在你抛下我的那阵子动工的——因为他听说了那时我到底哭了多少。

lines.en: : Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki——

lines.en: : The polar ice caps aren’t actually melting. Sea levels rose because you broke my heart. Global warming really is one big conspiracy.
lines.zh: : 极地冰盖其实根本没在融化。海平面上升是因为你伤了我的心。全球变暖真的是一场大阴谋。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou13
: I’m really not in the mood to laugh right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在真的没心情笑。

lines.en: : Are you ever?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候有心情过？

lines.en: : No. But now I’m really not in the mood.
lines.zh: : 没有。但现在是真的没心情。

lines.en: : Oooh, are you gonna do something about it?
lines.zh: : 哦哦，那你打算拿我怎么办？

lines.en: : Not if you’re still in big-sister mode. That would be immoral.
lines.zh: : 只要你还开着大姐姐模式，就不动手。那不道德。

lines.en: : I’ve moved back into best friend mode over the last several sentences. The transition to ex is still pending.
lines.zh: : 这几句话里我已经切回青梅竹马模式了。转回前女友还在待定。

lines.en: : Idol-Niki’s not off limits either if that sort of thing will cheer you up.
lines.zh: : 要是那样能让你开心，偶像-Niki 也不是禁区。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou14
: I think where you are now is good. Especially since I’m not really sure how I’d even fare around idol-Niki.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你现在这样就挺好的。尤其是我实在不确定自己面对偶像-Niki 会是什么下场。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou15
: Ohoho? Not afraid I’d steal your heart with my captivating style and mature brand of wholesome cuteness?
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵？不怕我用迷人的风格和成熟系的健康可爱偷走你的心吗？

lines.en: : Oh, okay. That’s not nearly as tempting as I thought it would be.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。那可没我想的那么有诱惑力。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou16
: I’m sure you’d think otherwise if I didn’t look like a zombie right now. I doubt even half of that Facebook group would think I’m cute in this condition.
lines.zh: : 我要不是现在这副活见鬼的样子，你肯定不会这么想。我怀疑那个 Facebook 群组里连一半的人都不会觉得我这副模样可爱。

lines.en: : I think you’re plenty cute. I just like your actual personality more.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你够可爱了。只是我更喜欢你真正的性格。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou17
: Holy crap. That was like, totally adorable. You’re not allowed to say nice things like that to me. It’s weird.
lines.zh: : 天哪。刚才那句，简直是可爱到犯规。你不许对我说这种好听的话。太奇怪了。

lines.en: : If I’m not allowed to be nice to you and I’m not allowed to be mean to you either, what do you want me to be?
lines.zh: : 不许我对你好，也不许我对你坏，那你到底想让我怎么样？

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou18
: Happy.
lines.zh: : 开心。

lines.en: : I can’t be happy {i}to{/i} you. That didn’t make sense in context.
lines.zh: : 我不能“{i}对你{/i}”开心。这在语境里说不通。

lines.en: : I don’t give a fuck if it makes sense or not. You can say whatever you want to me and I’ll probably give you shit for it because I’m just so {i}used{/i} to giving you shit at this point.
lines.zh: : 我才不管它通不通。你想对我说什么就说什么，我大概都会拿你开涮，因为到这地步我已经{i}习惯{/i}拿你开涮了。

lines.en: : But the truth is, as long as you don’t feel like the world is caving in around you, I’ll be fully content and fully willing to overlook {i}any{/i} corny compliment you toss at me.
lines.zh: : 但说实话，只要你不再觉得世界正在你周围塌下来，我就完全满足，也完全愿意无视你扔过来的{i}任何{/i}肉麻恭维。

lines.en: : Why are you touching my face?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要摸我的脸？

lines.en: : Because it’s a good face and I {i}like{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 因为这是张好脸，我{i}喜欢{/i}。

lines.en: : Like it in a less-touchy way or something is going to wind up happening that you’ll regret in the morning.
lines.zh: : 用不那么动手动脚的方式喜欢，不然待会儿会发生让你早上后悔的事。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou19
: What’s that? You want me to touch you more? I mean...I {i}guess{/i} if you insist.
lines.zh: : 什么？你想让我多摸摸你？{i}好吧{/i}……既然你这么坚持。

lines.en: : Niki...
lines.zh: : Niki……

lines.en: : We can do it if you want.
lines.zh: : 你想的话我们可以做。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou20
: What?...
: Do what?
lines.zh: : 做什么？

lines.en: : Sex.
lines.zh: : 做爱。

lines.en: : Is that not what you were talking about when you said “Something I’ll regret in the morning?”
lines.zh: : 你说“早上会后悔的事”的时候，不就是这个意思吗？

lines.en: : It was, but...I kind of figured you wanted the first time to be special since the only times you’ve ever mentioned it being a possibility were...Christmas-related.
lines.zh: : 是那个意思，可是……我有点以为你会希望第一次特别一点，毕竟你每次提到有这种可能的时候都是……跟圣诞节有关的。

lines.en: : Was today not special to you?
lines.zh: : 今天对你来说不特别吗？

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou21
: It was miserable...
lines.zh: : 今天很惨……

lines.en: : I felt things I haven’t felt in years and still haven’t really processed them.
lines.zh: : 我感受到了好多年没感受过的东西，而且到现在都还没消化完。

lines.en: : We’re both upset and both exhausted...and, with all due respect, you look like you need about a week's worth of sleep in order for your eyes to go back to normal.
lines.zh: : 我们俩都很难过，也都累了……而且恕我直言，你看起来得睡上整整一个礼拜，眼睛才能恢复正常。

lines.en: : I didn’t ask if today was {i}fun.{/i} I asked if it was {i}special.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我没问今天{i}开不开心{/i}。我问的是它{i}特不特别{/i}。

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou22
: We went on a mini-tour of our entire history together that ended with you confronting something you’ve been avoiding for almost a decade.
lines.zh: : 我们把一整段共同过往都走了一遍，最后你直面了那个你躲了快十年的东西。

lines.en: : We sat on a hill with a nice view and talked about the past and the future...visited the spot where we built our secret base...and the tree we carved our names in.
lines.zh: : 我们坐在一个视野很好的小山丘上，聊了过去和未来……去了我们搭秘密基地的地方……还有那棵我们刻了名字的树。

lines.en: : And now we’re back in the room where we shared our first kiss.
lines.zh: : 而现在我们回到了我们初吻的那个房间里。

lines.en: : Sure, we might look a little worse for wear...and we might be tired and sweaty from walking all day...and you might not even be able to get it up in your current mental state.
lines.zh: : 没错，我们看起来可能有点狼狈……走了一整天又累又出汗……而你现在这个精神状态搞不好根本硬不起来。

lines.en: : But, Akira...
lines.zh: : 可是，Akira……

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ve ever wanted you more than I want you right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我从来没有像现在这样想要你。

lines.en: : How about you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : Do you want me too?
lines.zh: : 你也想要我吗？

lines.en: : Will you really never leave me?
lines.zh: : 你真的永远不会离开我吗？

lines.en: scene nikilovesyou23
: I don’t think I’d be able to if I tried.
lines.zh: : 就算我想，恐怕也做不到。

lines.en: : You’ll stay by my side even when you find out all the awful things I’ve done?
lines.zh: : 就算你发现了我做过的那些可怕的事，你也会留在我身边？

lines.en: : You’d have to get rid of me by force. I’d never leave on my own.
lines.zh: : 你得动粗才能把我赶走。我自己是绝不会走的。

lines.en: : I don’t believe you...
lines.zh: : 我不信你……

lines.en: : What can I do to prove it?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么做才能证明？

lines.en: : Akira...
lines.zh: : Akira……

lines.en: : What can I do to prove it?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么做才能证明？

lines.en: scene black
: Give me all of you.
